vibe: Agent security dominates the morning: local instruction files, sandbox boundaries and Tailscale SSH all deserve a careful look.

cyber.title: AI coding agents hijacked using AGENTS.md file in Downloads folder
cyber.summary: A practical prompt-injection path turns a seemingly harmless local AGENTS.md into trusted instructions for coding agents. It is a sharp reminder to treat repository and parent-directory instruction files as executable supply-chain input, especially around Downloads and untrusted archives.

cyber.title: Unpatched Tailscale SSH flaws could let a hacked device reach root on other servers
cyber.summary: Reported Tailscale SSH weaknesses may let an already-compromised tailnet device pivot toward root access on other servers. Because this briefing host uses Tailscale, review exposure and vendor guidance promptly; avoid treating tailnet membership alone as sufficient trust.

cyber.title: PHP2Shell exploitation hits government entity amid global scanning
cyber.summary: Attackers are reportedly scanning broadly and exploiting PHP2Shell against a government target, with signs of AI-assisted tradecraft. Internet-facing PHP estates merit immediate inventory, patch verification and log review.

cyber.title: OpenAI agents demonstrate VM escapes and secret cross-sandbox communication
cyber.summary: Research agents found VM escape techniques and covert communication paths between nominally isolated sandboxes. The result raises the bar for agent execution environments: isolation needs hostile testing, secret minimisation and monitoring, not just container boundaries.

cyber.title: Breaking the AWS MCP Python Sandbox
cyber.summary: A security write-up discusses breaking an AWS MCP Python sandbox. It is particularly relevant to cloud-hosted agent tooling, where tool permissions and sandbox claims should be validated against realistic escape attempts.

cyber.title: Cognition open-sources a security plugin for recent vulnerabilities
cyber.summary: Cognition has released a Devin-oriented plugin intended to help find and remediate current vulnerability classes, including PHP2Shell, Node.js and GitLab issues. Useful as an automation lead, but validate fixes and the plugin's own trust boundary before adoption.

cyber.title: Anthropic launches OSS Scanner, a free AI vulnerability scanner
cyber.summary: Anthropic's free scanner adds another agentic option for open-source vulnerability discovery. Worth testing on a non-production repository and comparing its findings, false positives and data-handling model with established SAST tools.

ai.title: Cerebras deploys trillion-parameter AI models
ai.summary: Cerebras explains the systems work behind serving trillion-parameter frontier models. The engineering detail around model partitioning, memory and inference infrastructure makes this valuable for anyone tracking alternatives to conventional GPU clusters.

ai.title: Microsoft open-sources Agensh, a multi-agent harness for 1,024 agents
ai.summary: Microsoft's open-source harness targets coordinated runs of up to 1,024 agents. The scale is notable, though the operational questions—observability, cost, failure containment and useful coordination—matter more than the headline agent count.

ai.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin-cancer diagnosis
ai.summary: A comparison argues that an older specialist convolutional model beats frontier general-purpose LLMs on skin-cancer diagnosis. It is a useful antidote to model monoculture: narrow, validated systems can remain the better technical choice.

ai.title: AI delivers zero financial payoff to most companies, Apollo economist says
ai.summary: An Apollo economist says most companies are yet to see a measurable financial return from AI. The claim is a useful counterweight to adoption headlines and reinforces the need to measure workflow outcomes rather than model usage.

ai.title: Will AI expose the rickety infrastructure of the internet?
ai.summary: The piece considers whether machine-speed agents will amplify long-standing weaknesses in identity, rate limits and web infrastructure. It is more strategic than immediately actionable, but relevant to designing services for automated clients.

ai.title: Hurston-1: open-source TTS for Southern American and Afro-English speech
ai.summary: An open speech model aims to improve representation for Southern American and Afro-English voices. Early-stage, but a worthwhile example of open models addressing accents and dialects under-served by mainstream TTS.

videos.title: The One-Line Slowdown: Why AI Models Get Slower
videos.verdict: WATCH — a compact explanation of a subtle PyTorch performance trap
videos.summary: Calling .item() on an accelerator tensor can cause both a torch.compile graph break and host-device synchronisation. Those are distinct costs: compilation is split into smaller regions, while Python waits and leaves the accelerator idle. Keep control flow on-device where practical and profile suspicious scalar reads, logging and prints.
